notes.title: 🎮 BitSummit the 13th Exhibition Announcement 🎮
notes.content:
Joining BitSummit! First-ever Kansai Exhibition!
We are excited to announce our participation in BitSummit the 13th "Summer of Yokai"!
This marks the first-ever exhibition of "Menhera-rium" in the Kansai region!
[hr][/hr]📅 Event Overview
Event Dates

July 18, 2025 (Friday) - Business Day (Industry professionals only)

July 19-20, 2025 (Saturday & Sunday) - Public Days (Open to the public)

Event Hours
10:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Venue
Kyoto Municipal Industrial Promotion Hall "Miyako Messe"
9-1 Okazaki Seishoji-cho, Sakyo-ku, Kyoto 606-8343, Japan
[hr][/hr]🎮 Exhibition Content🎮 Menhera-rium
Latest Version debuts in Kansai for the first time!

"Menhera-rium," which has been well-received at events in the Kanto region, is finally making its Kansai debut!
At BitSummit the 13th, you'll be able to play the latest version.
[hr][/hr]📍 Booth Information
Booth Number: 3F-D58

Please come visit us!
[hr][/hr]📍 Access Information
By Train

Subway Tozai Line "Higashiyama Station" - 8-minute walk

Keihan Main Line "Sanjo Station" - 15-minute walk

City Bus "Okazaki Park Museum/Heian Shrine" - Right at the stop
[hr][/hr]
Kansai visitors, thank you for waiting!
The time has finally come for you to experience "Menhera-rium" in the Kansai region.
This is a rare opportunity to get hands-on experience with the latest version!

Additionally, BitSummit the 13th features numerous carefully selected indie games from Japan and around the world, beyond just "Menhera-rium." You'll discover games across various genres with unique personalities, enjoy interactions between developers, and participate in special yokai-themed events.

Please take this opportunity to enjoy "BitSummit," which is full of indie game charm!
